paragraphs: Hi, I’m Alex, a senior at Greenhill School in Dallas. I build tools at the intersection of AI, medicine, and sport.

Welcome to my desk. Everything here stands for something I’ve built. The binder is my research on AI for medical physics, the racket is a swing analyzer, and the glasses and chessboard are an AR chess coach. Click around, or open Projects for the full list.
